title: DC-area forecast: Pleasant sunshine today, before heat and humidity ramp up
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: Bright sunshine with highs in the low to mid-80s today. Humidity remains comfortable, with dew points around 60.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Bright sunshine with afternoon highs in the low to mid-80s and comfortable humidity.

What’s next? Heat and humidity start to ramp up tomorrow with a spotty afternoon shower. Heat indexes during the coming week feel more like July – it could feel close to 100 degrees by Tuesday and Wednesday – with a shower or storm possible here and there.

Today’s daily digit — 7/10: A solid late-summer day, with lower humidity, plenty of sunshine and no rain to worry about. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Saturday): A warm and bright start to the weekend, with mostly sunny skies and highs in the low to mid-80s. Dew points in the mid-50s to low 60s keep humidity comfortable and less sticky. Winds from the northeast stay light at around 10 mph. Confidence: Medium-High 😎 Nice Day!

Tonight: Overnight lows range through the 60s. Skies remain mostly clear, but some clouds develop toward Sunday morning as humidity begins to creep back up. Patchy fog is possible as well. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Sunday): Heat and humidity start to build, with highs in the mid-80s to near 90. Heat indexes could reach the low 90s as dew points climb into the upper 60s to near 70. Winds from the south stay light at around 10 mph. A spotty shower is possible during the afternoon, but most of the day looks dry. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Muggy lows dip into the low to mid-70s under partly cloudy skies. Confidence: Medium-High

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

The heat is on. Highs reach the low to mid-90s Monday and mid-90s Tuesday and Wednesday under partly sunny skies. High humidity Tuesday and Wednesday (dew points near 70) helps heat indexes rise into the upper 90s to near 100, adding to the hot and muggy feel. Each day has a chance of an isolated late-day shower or storm. Confidence: Medium

Highs could still be well into the 90s Thursday, with perhaps a higher chance of scattered showers and storms as a cold front moves into the region. That front should help temperatures trend back down to highs in the 80s, if not by Friday then at least for the Labor Day weekend.

DC weather history for August 29

Unseasonable chill in 1986 tied a record low for August, while in 1988 the remnants of Tropical Storm Chris brought soaking rains and gusty winds to the region.
